1.web: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
1.asv: We have heard with our ears, O God, Our fathers have told us, What work thou didst in their days, In the days of old.

2.web: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
2.asv: Thou didst drive out the nations with thy hand; But them thou didst plant: Thou didst afflict the peoples; But them thou didst spread abroad.

3.web: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.
3.asv: For they gat not the land in possession by their own sword, Neither did their own arm save them; But thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, Because thou wast favorable unto them.

4.web: You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!
4.asv: Thou art my King, O God: Command deliverance for Jacob.

5.web: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, will we tread them under who rise up against us.
5.asv: Through thee will we push down our adversaries: Through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

6.web: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
6.asv: For I will not trust in my bow, Neither shall my sword save me.

7.web: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.
7.asv: But thou hast saved us from our adversaries, And hast put them to shame that hate us.

8.web: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.
8.asv: In God have we made our boast all the day long, And we will give thanks unto thy name for ever. [Selah

9.web: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.
9.asv: But now thou hast cast us off, and brought us to dishonor, And goest not forth with our hosts.

10.web: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.
10.asv: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; And they that hate us take spoil for themselves.

11.web: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.
11.asv: Thou hast made us like sheep appointed for food, And hast scattered us among the nations.

12.web: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.
12.asv: Thou sellest thy people for nought, And hast not increased thy wealth by their price.

13.web: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
13.asv: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbors, A scoffing and a derision to them that are round about us.

14.web: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
14.asv: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, A shaking of the head among the peoples.

15.web: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,
15.asv: All the day long is my dishonor before me, And the shame of my face hath covered me,

16.web: At the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.
16.asv: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth, By reason of the enemy and the avenger.

17.web: All this has come on us, yet have we not forgotten you, Neither have we been false to your covenant.
17.asv: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, Neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

18.web: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,
18.asv: Our heart is not turned back, Neither have our steps declined from thy way,

19.web: Though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
19.asv: That thou hast sore broken us in the place of jackals, And covered us with the shadow of death.

20.web: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god;
20.asv: If we have forgotten the name of our God, Or spread forth our hands to a strange god;

21.web: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.
21.asv: Will not God search this out? For he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

22.web: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.
22.asv: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; We are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

23.web: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
23.asv: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? Arise, cast us not off for ever.

24.web: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
24.asv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, And forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

25.web: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.
25.asv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: Our body cleaveth unto the earth.

26.web: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
26.asv: Rise up for our help, And redeem us for thy lovingkindness’ sake.
